bar-selected.why: The restored filter reads Filtered: Reported Term = Nausea, in the column's label.

interactions/click-bar-color.why: The MODERATE segment of Rash sends AETERM and AESEV and only that segment stays lit; the missing-severity segment sends AETERM = Rash and AESEV = null (a missing value is a key too) and lights only that segment instead of clearing; the footer names both columns, the missing one as (missing).

interactions/click-bar-facet-drill-colum.why: The click sends the USUBJID values of the clicked panel's rows (as v1) and latches that filter: the footer names it, and every bar holding those patients is lit, in any panel; the second click resends instead of clearing.

interactions/click-bar-grouped-vertical.why: The MODERATE bar of Rash sends AETERM and AESEV and only that bar stays lit; the footer names both columns.

interactions/click-bar-latched.why: A second click on Nausea sends the filter again and keeps it lit instead of clearing; clicks send filters: {AETERM: [...]}; the footer names the column label.

interactions/click-bar-transient.why: The drill event sends filters: {AETERM: [Nausea]}; the receipt reads Drilled down to Reported Term = Nausea.

interactions/click-bar-transient-drill-c.why: The drill event sends filters: {USUBJID: [...]}; the receipt names nine values as USUBJID, 9 values.

interactions/click-boxplot.why: A second click on Week 4 resends and keeps it lit instead of clearing; clicks send filters: {AVISIT: [...]}; the footer names the column.

interactions/click-boxplot-color.why: A box sends AVISIT and ARM and only that box stays lit; the other arm's box in the same visit is a new filter, not a toggle; the footer names both columns.

interactions/click-boxplot-facet.why: The click sends the USUBJID values under the clicked box (as v1) and latches that filter: the footer names it, and the boxes holding those patients are lit.

interactions/click-gantt.why: Clicks send filters: {AETERM: [...]} (the message D2/D3 extend); the footer names the column label (Reported Term = Rash); the lanes outside the filter dim, where v1 dimmed nothing; Reset clears with filter_type categorical, the type it latched, and lights every bar again.

interactions/click-gantt-drill-column.why: The click sends filters: {USUBJID: [S01]}, and the footer names that filter (USUBJID = S01) instead of the lane (Rash); the bars of other patients dim.

interactions/click-gantt-facet.why: A click in the Low Dose panel filters USUBJID = S02 and ARM = Low Dose, the footer says both in column labels, and every other bar dims.

interactions/click-gantt-facet-drill-col.why: The click sends filters: {AETERM: [Headache]}, the drill column only, without the facet; the footer names that filter; the bars outside it dim.

interactions/click-gantt-transient.why: The drill event sends filters: {AETERM: [Rash]}; the receipt reads Drilled down to Reported Term = Rash.

interactions/click-pie.why: A second click on SEVERE resends and keeps it lit instead of clearing; clicks send filters: {AESEV: [...]}; the footer names the column.

interactions/click-pie-facet.why: A slice in the M panel sends AESEV and SEX = M and only that panel's slice stays lit; MILD in another panel is a new filter, not a toggle; the footer names both columns.

interactions/click-pie-transient.why: The drill event from the F panel sends AESEV = MILD and SEX = F.

interactions/click-pointrange.why: Clicks send filters: {AVISIT: [...]}; the footer names the column; the point ranges outside the filter dim, where v1 dimmed nothing.

interactions/click-pointrange-color.why: The first dot sends AVISIT and ARM; the footer names both columns; the other point ranges dim, where v1 dimmed nothing.

interactions/click-radar-color.why: Clicks send filters: {ARM: [...]}; the footer names the column label.

interactions/click-radar-drill-column.why: The click sends filters: {USUBJID: [...]} and the footer names that filter (USUBJID, 4 values) instead of the shape.

interactions/click-radar-facet.why: A shape in the M panel sends AESEV = MILD and SEX = M, and the MILD shape of the F panel dims; the footer names both columns.

interactions/click-treemap.why: A second click on Nausea resends and keeps it lit instead of clearing; clicks send filters: {AETERM: [...]}; the footer names the column label.

interactions/click-waterfall.why: A click on the base under the latched step resends Week 2 instead of clearing; clicks send filters: {AVISIT: [...]}; the footer names the column.

interactions/export-capture-throws.why: The hidden capture host is removed when the payload throws.

interactions/export-capture-timeout.why: The hidden capture host is removed when the capture times out.

interactions/gear-drive-bar-selection-th.why: The click sends filters: {AETERM: [Nausea]} and the footer names the column; the group change that clears the filter shows No filter active at once and lights every bar.

interactions/life-initialize-twice.why: A second initialize disposes the old view's ECharts instance.

interactions/life-remount.why: A re-mount under the same id disposes the old view's instances.

interactions/restore-bar-column-differs.why: A restored USUBJID = S01 lights the bars that hold rows of S01 instead of dimming every bar.

interactions/restore-bar-echo-keeps.why: The click sends filters: {AETERM: [Rash]}; the footer names the column label.

interactions/restore-bar-multi.why: The restored Nausea and Headache both light; a click on the SEVERE segment of Nausea sends AETERM and AESEV; the footer names the column labels.

interactions/restore-bar-single.why: A click on the restored Nausea resends and keeps it instead of clearing; clicks send filters: {AETERM: [...]}; the footer names the column label.

interactions/restore-gantt.why: The restored filter reads Filtered: Reported Term = Rash, in the column's label, and the lanes other than Rash dim.

interactions/restore-radar.why: The restored filter reads Filtered: Planned Arm = Placebo.

interactions/restore-receipt.why: The drill event sends filters: {AETERM: [Nausea]}; the receipt reads Drilled down to Reported Term = Nausea.

interactions/restore-treemap.why: The restored filter reads Filtered: Reported Term = Rash.

interactions/brush-scatter-geometric.why: The brush footer names the range that was sent (Analysis Relative Day 2 to 86, Analysis Value 21.4 to 30.0) instead of Brush filter active.

interactions/brush-scatter-ignored-event.why: A brush on points outside the data selects nothing and latches nothing (v1 showed Brush filter active and sent nothing); the brush that caught a point names its range in the footer.

interactions/brush-scatter-color.why: The brush sends filters: {ARM: [...]} and the footer names it; its clear carries filter_type categorical, the type it latched.

interactions/brush-scatter-facet.why: The brush sends filters: {AESEV: [...]} and the footer names it.

interactions/brush-scatter-drill-column.why: The brush sends filters: {USUBJID: [...]} and the footer names it.

interactions/brush-scatter-drill-off.why: With drill off an empty brush event sends nothing (v1 sent a clear).

interactions/brush-scatter-transient.why: The brush sends filters: {ARM: [...]} and the footer names it; its clear carries filter_type categorical, the type it latched.

interactions/brush-scatter-click-guard.why: A brush clear after the click guard clears the latched point and the footer says No filter active (v1 kept naming the point); the point is named in column labels.

interactions/brush-line-event.why: The brush footer names the x range that was sent (Analysis Relative Day 0 to 1).

interactions/brush-scatter-duplicate-poi.why: The brush sends filters: {ID: [a, b, c, d]}; the footer names it (ID, 4 values).

interactions/click-scatter-geometric.why: The point click sends the same zero-width range; the footer names it in column labels (Analysis Relative Day = 15, Analysis Value = 29.2) instead of the bare coordinates.

interactions/click-scatter-color.why: Colour no longer widens a point click to its arm: each click sends a zero-width range at the point instead of ARM = Placebo; the footer names the point in column labels.

interactions/click-scatter-series.why: The point selects its series, sent as filters: {USUBJID: [S03]}; the footer names it (USUBJID = S03) instead of the point's coordinates; the other patients' points dim.

interactions/click-scatter-facet-drill-c.why: The click sends the USUBJID of the rows under the point as filters: {USUBJID: [...]}; the footer names it; the points of other patients dim, in every panel.

interactions/click-scatter-transient.why: With colour only, a point click is the point itself, a zero-width range: no claim to send to the target, so it latches a local range filter (as a geometric click did) instead of sending ARM = Placebo; the footer names the point.

interactions/click-scatter-transient-geo.why: The footer names the latched point in column labels.

interactions/click-line-series.why: Clicks send filters: {USUBJID: [...]}; the footer names the column (USUBJID = S03); the other lines dim; Reset clears with filter_type categorical, the type it latched, and lights every line again.

interactions/click-line-hover-wins.why: The hovered line S02 is sent as filters: {USUBJID: [S02]}; the footer names the column; the other lines dim.

interactions/click-line-color-only.why: The line is sent as filters: {SEX: [F]}; the footer names the column; the other line dims.

interactions/click-line-no-split.why: The footer names the clicked point in column labels.

interactions/click-band-color.why: A click on the High Dose centre line selects that level and sends ARM = High Dose, where v1 sent nothing and named a computed point; the footer says Planned Arm = High Dose; the other levels dim.

interactions/click-band-plain.why: An uncoloured band is not clickable: nothing is sent or latched, where v1 sent a zero-width range at a computed point.

interactions/restore-scatter.why: The restored ARM = Placebo reads Planned Arm = Placebo, and the points of the other arms dim, where v1 dimmed nothing.

interactions/restore-line.why: The restored USUBJID = S03 dims the other lines, where v1 dimmed nothing.

interactions/restore-brush.why: The brush footer names the range in column labels (Analysis Relative Day 1 to 15, Analysis Value 27.4 to 29.2) instead of Brush filter active.
